aboutH2: Cedars Recovery: Addiction, Mental Health and Trauma Treatment in Cobble Hill, BC
intro: Cedars Recovery, known until recently as Cedars at Cobble Hill, is a private residential treatment centre on southern Vancouver Island. It has treated addiction for more than 20 years and now also treats mental health and trauma, with medically supervised detox on site and one year of post-treatment care included in the cost.

Cedars at Cobble Hill specializes in treating individuals suffering from alcohol and drug addiction, eating disorders, sex addiction, and gambling addiction. The team at Cedars has extensive experience in treating addictions and provides medical detoxification, residential therapy, post-treatment programs, and continuing care. Their treatment programs are gender-specific and customized to meet client’s specific needs, ensuring that each individual receives the best possible care. Cedars at Cobble Hill utilizes a holistic approach that incorporates various evidence-based therapies and complementary therapies, including 12-step facilitation, motivational interviewing, and art therapy. The length of stay at Cedars is tailored to the client’s goals, and upon completion, continuing care is provided to ensure long-term success.

pillars.title: Sixty Forested Acres in the Cowichan Valley
pillars.body: The environment at Cedars at Cobble Hill is tranquil and allows clients to enjoy the beauty of nature. The facility is set on 60 acres with breathtaking views of the forest that surrounds it. The facility is modern and built to have a log-cabin style to add elegance to the house renovations. The architecture brings in a natural element that enhances the space and inspires tranquility. Clients can make use of the natural splendor of the British Columbia West coast for meditation, relaxation, and taking long walks in the woods. Clients have access to numerous outdoor trails which are surrounded by trees, providing a serene setting that facilitates healing and recovery.

pillars.title: A Year of Aftercare and Sober Living in Surrey
pillars.body: Everyone who finishes treatment at Cedars gets 12 months of post-treatment care at no extra cost. That covers daily virtual mutual aid groups, three facilitated process groups a week, a recovery coach, access to a clinical counsellor and weekly alumni meetings on site or online. People who want more structure can move into Cedars Supportive Recovery Living, staffed recovery homes on the edge of Surrey near White Rock with 24/7 staff, one-to-one counselling and life skills work. Families can take the Discovery Family Program, run as a weekend or over four Tuesday evenings.

pillars.title: Doctors, Counsellors and People in Recovery
pillars.body: The medical side is led by Dr. Gerrit Prinsloo, a family physician board certified in addiction medicine in Canada and the United States, who worked in addiction medicine at St. Paul's Hospital in Vancouver. Psychiatrist Dr. Daniel Boston and addiction physician Dr. David Browning see patients on campus, and nurses are on the team around the clock during detox. Clinical Director Jennifer Kent Charpentier has more than 30 years in the addiction field. Chief Executive Stacey Petersen, a registered social worker, has been in recovery since 1987, and the centre says many of its staff have lived experience too.

overview: Cedars at Cobble Hill is a specialized rehab center dedicated to treating addiction disorders. The team understands that each patient is unique and deserves a personalized treatment plan. To achieve this goal, thorough assessments are performed throughout the treatment process to ensure the patient is responding positively to the treatment. Cedars’ programs are always invitational, never confrontational, and they do not use a one-size-fits-all approach. Instead, the clinical and support staff will encourage and guide each patient towards their full recovery, which will enable them to improve their self-esteem, develop fulfilling relationships, and accomplish individual goals.
serviceCaption: 12 services · as described on the centre's website
afterOverview: The center’s gender-specific residences were designed to provide a private and safe environment for patients during their addiction treatment journey. Although co-ed integration is important in several stages of the program, Cedars at Cobble Hill offers gender-specific housing and women’s group activities to foster a safe and harmonious environment for each patient. Through this gender-specific approach, patients can experience open and accepting group dynamics that eliminate external distractions and provide comfort. Along with an inviting atmosphere, the center offers a range of amenities and holistic therapies, including evidence-based practices, yoga, and meditation, individual and group therapy, family counseling, and art and nature therapy to help patients achieve sustainable recovery.

Cedars at Cobble Hill provides patients with a comfortable and safe environment. The facility is designed based on the principles of Feng Shui, which promotes the importance of natural flow art and quality balance. The facility has gender-specific housing options that provide privacy and a sense of community for clients. The log cabin-style residences have exposed beams, hardwood floors, and river-rock fireplaces, which add to the natural beauty of the environment. The on-site gym and yoga studio help clients take care of their physical health during their treatment. Upon completion of treatment, clients have the option to extend their stay through the continuing care program, which provides ongoing support and guidance.

location.heading: Cedars Recovery in Cobble Hill, British Columbia
location.intro: Cedars Recovery is on Holland Avenue in Cobble Hill, a rural community in the Cowichan Valley on southern Vancouver Island, a few minutes from Mill Bay and Shawnigan Lake. From Vancouver it takes about three hours with the BC Ferries crossing to Nanaimo or Swartz Bay; Victoria is about 45 minutes south over the Malahat, Duncan about 15 minutes north and Nanaimo about an hour.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Cedars Recovery cost?
faqs.a: Cedars' recovery.com profile lists inpatient treatment at $24,000 to $26,000 per 30 days. The centre's own website does not publish fees, so confirm the current price with admissions at 1-866-716-2006. Medical detox and a year of post-treatment care are included in the cost of treatment.

faqs.q: What is Cedars at Cobble Hill?
faqs.a: Cedars at Cobble Hill is a leading addiction treatment center in North America, specializing in the treatment of alcohol and drug addiction, eating disorders, sex addiction, and gambling addiction.

faqs.q: Is Cedars at Cobble Hill the same as Cedars Recovery?
faqs.a: Yes. The centre now goes by Cedars Recovery, and cedarscobblehill.com redirects to cedarsrecovery.com. It is the same campus at 3741 Holland Avenue in Cobble Hill, with the same phone number.

faqs.q: What is the length of stay for clients?
faqs.a: The length of stay at Cedars is tailored to the client’s goals and needs. Recovery.com lists a typical residential stay of 30 days, with a range of 14 to 90 days.

Yes, Cedars has medically supervised detox on campus and it is included in the cost of treatment. Medical Director Dr. Gerrit Prinsloo leads it, and patients get 24-hour care before moving straight into the inpatient program.

faqs.q: How do I get to Cedars Recovery from Vancouver?
faqs.a: Plan on about three hours. Take BC Ferries from Horseshoe Bay to Nanaimo and drive about an hour south, or from Tsawwassen to Swartz Bay and drive up past Victoria and over the Malahat. Call admissions before you travel so they can plan your arrival.

faqs.q: Is there a continuing care program?
faqs.a: Yes, Cedars provides a continuing care program to ensure long-term success. Everyone who completes treatment gets 12 months of post-treatment care, including daily virtual support groups, a recovery coach and weekly alumni meetings.

Cedars is a private-pay centre. Its recovery.com profile lists private pay and no insurance plans, so ask admissions for receipts you can submit to an extended health or employer plan for possible reimbursement.

Yes. Cedars Supportive Recovery Living runs staffed recovery homes on the edge of Surrey near White Rock, with staff on site 24/7, counselling, a recovery coach and three clinician-led groups a week. The homes are open to anyone extending their recovery, not only Cedars alumni.

faqs.q: What kind of therapies are available at Cedars?
faqs.a: Cedars utilizes a range of therapies, including individual therapy, group therapy, motivational interviewing, and art therapy.

faqs.q: What kind of options for residential therapy are available?
faqs.a: Cedars offers gender-specific housing options and facilities for medical detox.

faqs.q: Where is Cedars at Cobble Hill located?
faqs.a: Cedars is located on 60 acres of land in British Columbia West coast.

faqs.q: What kind of outdoor activities are available for clients?
faqs.a: Clients have access to numerous outdoor trails surrounded by trees, which provides a serene setting for relaxation and meditation.

faqs.q: Does Cedars at Cobble Hill provide yoga or fitness programs?
faqs.a: Yes, Cedars provides an on-site gym and yoga studio for physical health.
